response.sql: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), allavg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS all_avg FROM eq), above AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, allavg.all_avg FROM eq CROSS JOIN allavg WHERE eq.avg_hum > allavg.all_avg), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM above) SELECT above.equipref AS equipment_reference, above.avg_hum AS average_humidity, above.avg_hum - above.all_avg AS exceeds_all_equipment_avg, above.avg_hum - grp.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM above CROSS JOIN grp WHERE above.all_avg IS NOT NULL AND grp.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
